description: This source file defines a class 'AnswerWithSelf' implementing Mockito's 'Answer' interface, used to customize mock behavior. It overrides the 'answer' method to return the mock instance itself if compatible, otherwise defers to default answer behavior.

classes.name: AnswerWithSelf
classes.description: A custom implementation of Mockito's 'Answer' interface that returns the mock object itself when appropriate, or defaults otherwise.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Overrides the 'answer' method to return the mock object itself if the return type is compatible; otherwise, delegates to default answer.
